results.title: Sphere Abacus appoints Niki Page as acquisitions manager in scripted and unscripted push | Broadcast
results.content:
Page added: “I’m absolutely thrilled to be joining Sphere Abacus. It’s a fantastic company with an incredibly talented team and an impressive catalogue, and I’m excited to be part of it and to bring my experience, relationships and passion for great content to the business.”

The appointment comes two days after Sphere Abacus bought Matthew Frank’s Rights Booster, having itself been acquired by Canada’s Bell last year. [...] She will work alongside global content director, Will Stapley and joins having most recently been senior vice president of commercial at Deep Fusion.

Page has previously held senior roles at Sky, Fremantle, Channel 4, and Seven.One (fka Red Arrow Studios), working on shows ranging from Jamie Oliver, Don’t Tell the Bride and Chateau DIY, to The Wine Show and the podcast Virtually Parkinson. [...] AI Media News

2026-09-16T08:42:00+01:00

Niki Page to work across scripted and unscripted deals at Bell Media-backed company

Sphere Abacus has appointed Niki Page from AI production company Deep Fusion to work across acquisitions.
